source: 700 Return
target: 700 Reditus

source: In the special dream, Amandina mentioned that the figure, known as the Underworld Daoist, had nodded at her…
target: In somnio speciali, Amandina memoravit figuram, nota ut "Daoista Inferorum", quae ei nutaverat…

source: "Armored Shadow" Chen Tu is suspected to be related to the Underworld Daoist…
target: Chen Tu, "Umbra Armata", suspicatur esse cognatus Daoista Inferorum…

source: Franca is accumulating gold to create a golden body for Chen Tu to obtain more information…
target: Franca aurum colligit ut corpus aureum pro Chen Tu efficiat, quo plura discat…

source: Lumian’s mind raced with these thoughts.
target: Mens Lumiani his cogitationibus volitabat.

source: He turned to Amandina with a smile.
target: Subrisu se ad Amandinam convertit.

source: “You won’t only encounter that figure during the Dream Festival.”
target: Non solum, in Festival Somniorum, illam figuram occursurus eris.

source: “It’s possible normally?” Amandina asked, surprised.
target: “Num etiam more solito fit?” inquit Amandina, stupens.

source: What kind of smarts do you have… Lumian inwardly criticized, shaking his head and smiling.
target: "Quae ingenia geris..." internaliter reprehendit Lumian, caput concutens et subridens.

source: “What I mean is, it’s not just in Tizamo where you can encounter that figure on a specific date.”
target: "Quod scilicet dico, non solum in Tizamo, certo die, illam figuram occursurum esse potes."

source: Amandina pondered for a few moments before grasping the underlying meaning behind Louis Berry’s words.
target: Amandina paulisper meditavit, deinde latentem significationem verborum Ludovici Berry intellexit.

source: “Have you seen that figure elsewhere?
target: "Illam figuram alibi vidistine?

source: “I thought you couldn’t see him and could only observe through me?”
target: “Putabam te eum videre non posse et solum per me conspicere?”

source: Thankfully, you’re not that dense… Lumian retrieved the golden mask from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Gratias autem, non es tam obtusus… Lumian larvam auream ex sacculo viatoris extraxit.

source: “I could see after putting this on.”
target: “Hoc indutum, videre potui.”

source: Without waiting for Amandina’s response, Lumian added with a smile, “I did encounter that figure elsewhere.”
target: Nisi responsum Amandinae exspectans, Lumian subridens addidit: "Illam figuram alibi occurrivi."

source: He used “encounter” instead of “meeting” to ensure his statement couldn’t be more truthful.
target: Verbum "occurrere" pro "conventu" usus est, ut sententia eius non posset verius esse.

source: He wanted to say, “I even know His name,” but didn’t feel like explaining to Amandina why he used the pronoun “He” to address the Underworld Daoist respectfully.
target: Volebat dicere: "Etiam nomen Eius novi," sed non voluit Amandinae explicare cur pronomen "Is" ad reverenter referendum ad Daoista Inferorum adhiberet.

source: Amandina’s expression turned excited.
target: Vultus Amandinae excitatus factus est.

source: “Where?”
target: "Ubi?"

source: “In Trier,” Lumian replied honestly.
target: "In Trier," respondit Lumian sincere.

source: This was the information he wanted the other party to know.
target: Haec erant notitiae, quas alteri tradere volebat.

source: “Trier…” Amandina felt a mix of captivation and fear.
target: "Trier..." Amandina mixturam captivationis et timoris sensit.

source: As an Intisian born and raised on the Southern Continent, she had heard countless rumors about the Capital of Joy and understood its vibrancy and prosperity.
target: Sicut Intisiana in Continentis Australis nata et educata, innumeros rumores de Capite Laetitiae audiverat et eius vibrantiam ac prosperitatem intellexerat.

source: Trier had nearly become her dream paradise, but the furthest she had ventured was Port Pylos, never leaving Matani.
target: Trier fere paradisus somniorum eius factus erat, sed remotissimum pervenit ad Portum Pylos, numquam Matani relinquit.

source: If given the chance to visit Trier, fear was her initial reaction.
target: Si occasio Trier visitandi ei daretur, timor primarius erat.

source: After all, she was still a girl under 18.
target: Postremo, adhuc puella sub duodeviginti annis erat.

source: Lumian continued candidly, “In the future, I know someone who might interact with that figure.
target: Lumian candide persequebatur: "In futuro, scio aliquem qui cum illa figura agere possit.

source: I hope you can provide her with some assistance—the non-combat kind.
target: Spero te ei auxilium ferre posse—non bellicum.

source: To that end, I can take you to Trier and help you enter the area where the figure might appear.
target: Ad hoc, te ad Trier ducam et tibi adiuvabo ad locum ingredi, ubi figura apparere possit.

source: I can also provide some protection.
target: Praeterea, aliquam tutelam praebere possum.

source: How about it? Do you want to strike such a deal?
target: Quid censes? Visne talem pactum facere?

source: “I-I…” Amandina hesitated, instinctively seeking an excuse.
target: "I-I..." titubavit Amandina, instinctive excusationem quaerens.

source: “My parents won’t allow me to leave Matani for Trier now.
target: "Parentes mei non sinunt me nunc ex Matani ad Trier discedere.

source: At the very least, I have to wait until I get a chance to attend university there.”
target: "Saltem, oportet me exspectare donec occasio ad universitatem ibi accedat."

source: Lumian found it amusing and remarked, “I’m not asking you to permanently relocate to Trier.
target: Lumian hoc risu accepit et dixit: "Non te peto ut in Trier perpetuo resideas.

source: You can go on Saturday and return on Sunday.”
target: Potes sabbato discedere et die dominico redire.

source: “Huh?” Amandina was taken aback.
target: "Eh?" Amandina stupefacta est.

source: She had imagined a long-distance voyage, hiking through mountains and wading across rivers, forever bidding farewell to her home.
target: Iter longum imaginaverat, per montes ambulans et flumina calcans, domum suam in perpetuum vale dicens.

source: Lumian arched an eyebrow.
target: Lumian unius supercilium levavit.

source: “It’s not like I haven’t teleported you in the dream before.”
target: "Non enim est quod te ante in somnio non translocaverim."

source: “B-but isn’t that just a small area?” Amandina’s eyes lit up.
target: "Sed—num non est illud parva regio?" oculi Amandinae fulserunt.

source: “Can you really teleport directly from Matani to Trier?”
target: "Num vere directe ab Matani ad Trier te translocare potes?"

source: Lumian nodded slightly.
target: Lumian leviter annuit.

source: “Yes, I might need to make a transit once or twice along the way, but it will still allow you to reach Trier quickly.”
target: "Ita, semel vel bis transeundum iter facere mihi opus esse potest, sed celeriter ad Trier pervenies."

source: “Quickly…” Amandina’s interest was piqued.
target: "Celeriter..." studium Amandinae excitatum est.

source: She yearned to experience such wonders.
target: Talia miracula experiri cupiebat.

source: However, she didn’t make a decision immediately.
target: Tamen statim non decrevit.

source: Lumian didn’t rush her.
target: Lumian eam non festinavit.

source: “No need to decide right away.
target: "Non necesse est statim decernere.

source: Meeting that figure again is actually quite dangerous.
target: Iterum illam figuram convenire vere periculosum est.

source: You should first truly come into contact with Matani’s mysticism circle and learn the basics about Beyonders from Rhea.
target: Primum vere oportet te cum circulo mystico Matani contiguum esse et a Rhea elementa de Beyonders discere.

source: Only then should you consider accepting this deal.
target: Tum solum deberes hunc pactum accipere considerare.

source: It might take three months, half a year, or even a year.”
target: Tribus mensibus, dimidio anno, vel etiam uno anno tempus capere potest.

source: Amandina breathed a sigh of relief.
target: Amandina leviter suspiravit.

source: “Understood.”
target: "Intelligo."

source: Curious, she asked, “Is your friend a woman?”
target: Curiosa inquit: "Num amica tua sit femina?"

source: He had used the pronoun “she.”
target: Pronomen "ea" usus erat.

source: In our hearts and minds, she has always been one.
target: In cordibus et mentibus nostris, semper una fuit.

source: As for how she identifies, sometimes yes, sometimes no…
target: Quoad modum quo se agnoscit, aliquando sic, aliquando non…

source: Lumian inwardly criticized Franca and nodded slightly.
target: Lumian Francam internis rationibus reprehendens leviter annuit.

source: “Yes.”
target: "Ita."

source: Amandina asked excitedly, “Your lover?”
target: Amandina exsultans inquit: "Amator tuus?"

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridens erat.

source: “Of course not.
target: "Certe non.

source: Why do you always fixate on such matters?”
target: Cur semper talibus rebus insisteris?”

source: As Lumian spoke, he retrieved a post-it note and fountain pen from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Dum Lumian loquebatur, notam post-it et calamo plumbeo ex sacculo viatoris extraxit.

source: He scribbled a few lines and handed them to Amandina.
target: Paucas lineas scripsit et Amandinae tradidit.

source: Amandina took it and carefully read it under the cathedral’s candlelight:
target: Amandina id suscepit et sub lumine candelarum cathedralium diligenter legit:

source: “A creature wandering above the world, the penitent who awakens from the flames of pain, a messenger that belongs solely to Lumian Lee.”
target: "Creatura per orbem errans, paenitens qui ex flammarum dolore evigilat, nuntius cui soli Lumian Lee pertinet."

source: “What’s this?” Amandina was bewildered.
target: "Quid hoc est?" inquit Amandina, stupefacta.

source: “My messenger.
target: "Nuntius meus.

source: Set up a ritual once you’ve made up your mind.
target: Constitue ritum, simul ac mente definita es.

source: Use this incantation to summon my messenger and inform me of your decision,” Lumian explained simply.
target: Hoc incantationem utere ad nuntium meum evocandum, et me de tua decisione certiorem fac, explicavit Lumian simpliciter.

source: Amandina grew increasingly perplexed.
target: Amandina magis magisque perplexa facta est.

source: “What ritual?
target: "Quid ritus?

source: What summoning?
target: "Quam evocationem?

source: This isn’t a conventional messenger?”
target: "Nonne hic nuntius solitus est?"

source: Lumian raised his eyebrows again.
target: Lumian iterum supercilia levavit.

source: “Have you never heard of a messenger in the mysticism domain?
target: "Num nunquam nuntium in dominio mystico audivisti?

source: Don’t you know about summoning rituals?”
target: "Nonne de ritibus evocationis nosti?"

source: Amandina smiled sheepishly and said, “I came into contact with superpowers last year and gathered some information about the pathways of the divine through Robert and a few mysticism enthusiasts.
target: Amandina submissa risu surridens inquit: "Anno praeterito cum potentia supernaturali occurui et per Robertum atque paucos studiosos mysticae viarum informationes collegi.

source: I know about rituals, but I’m not sure about the details.”
target: De ritibus scio, sed de singulis non plenissime certus sum.

source: Then, her eyes lit up.
target: Tum oculi eius fulserunt.

source: “You’ll teach me, won’t you?
target: "Mihi docebis, nonne?"

source: Otherwise, I wouldn’t be able to summon your messenger.
target: Aliter nuntium tuum evocare non possem.

source: Also, is your real name not Louis Berry, but Lumian Lee?
target: Etiam, num verum nomen tuum non est Louis Berry, sed Lumian Lee?

source: “Y-you took a pen and paper from that coin bag.
target: "Tu... tu penna et chartam ex illo sacculo nummorum abstulisti.

source: You also took your previous items from there.
target: Etiam veteres res tuas ex eo abstulisti.

source: What kind of mystical item is this?
target: Quidnam huiusmodi res mystica est?

source: Lumian couldn’t help but glance up at the golden spherical dome.
target: Lumian non potuit non intueri ad auream sphaericam cupulam.

source: The following morning, Lumian left the Brieu Motel with Ludwig and Lugano.
target: Postero mane, Lumian cum Ludovico et Lugano Brieu Motel reliquit.

source: They passed through streets still strewn with ruins and arrived at Bunia’s café.
target: Per vias quae adhuc ruinibus sparsae erant, perrexerunt et ad cauponam Buniae pervenerunt.

source: The owner, Bunia, maintained his usual shyness and politely inquired about their needs.
target: Dominus, Bunia, consuetam timiditatem servavit et comiter de eorum necessitatibus interrogavit.

source: Lumian ordered three cups of Cosa coffee and three servings of Matani’s specialty breakfast, Ocapa.
target: Lumian tres pocula coffeae Cosae et tres portiones ientaculi specialis Matani, Ocapa, iussit.

source: Ocapa was made from rice, chicken, eggs, potatoes, and common local spices wrapped in leaves from the Ocapa trees.
target: Ocapa facta erat ex oryza, gallina, ova, patatae, et condimentis localibus in foliis arborum Ocapa involutis.

source: It was filling and fragrant, and one couldn’t stop eating once they started.
target: Saturabat et fragrans erat, nec quisquam desinere comedere poterat, cum coepisset.

source: Lumian gazed at the spread of Ocapa, picked up his cutlery, and scooped a spoonful into his mouth.
target: Lumian praeparationem Ocapa contemplatus, utensilia sua sustulit, et cochlearem in os suum admisit.

source: The fragrance of the leaves, the salted egg yolk, the weightiness of the rice, the tenderness of the chicken, the softness of the potatoes, and the strange rich aroma combined to create a unique texture.
target: Fragrantia foliorum, vitellus salatus, gravitas oryzae, teneritas gallinae, mollitia patatarum, et insolitus dives odor simul confluunt ut texturam unicam creent.

source: As Lumian ate, he casually surveyed the pedestrians and café patrons on the street.
target: Dum Lumian edebat, pedestres et convivas cauponae in platea leviter observabat.

source: After the sorrow and fear of the previous night, they had become gentle again, no longer revealing excessive emotions.
target: Post dolorem et timorem noctis praeteritae, iterum miti facti erant, neque nimias affectus ostendebant.

source: When they spoke to others, they always had a faint smile on their faces.
target: Cum aliis loquebantur, in vultibus semper tenui risu lucebat.

source: After Ludwig finished his second meal of the morning, Lumian found a secluded corner, changed into winter clothes, and disappeared from Tizamo with him and Lugano.
target: Postquam Ludovicus secundae mensae matutinae consummavit, Lumian angulum solitarium invenit, in vestimenta hiemalia se mutavit, et cum eo atque Lugano ex Tizamo evanuit.

source: This time, Lumian refrained from teleporting directly to Franca, as Lugano, Ludwig, and the two Demonesses were unfamiliar with each other.
target: Hoc tempore, Lumian directam translocationem ad Francam fugere constituit, quoniam Lugano, Ludovicus, et duae Daemones inter se ignotae erant.

source: Lumian chose the rarely used entrance to Underground Trier in Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative.
target: Lumian ingressum raro adhibitum in Trier subterraneum, in Quartiere de la Cathédrale Commémorative, elegit.

source: The trio swiftly outlined themselves on the steel steps.
target: Trio celeriter se in gradibus ferreis compaginaverunt.

source: Upon returning to the surface, Lumian spotted a few college students carrying carbide lamps and lanterns.
target: Cum in superficiem rediit, Lumian paucos studiosos collegii lucernas carbide et lanternas ferentes conspexit.

source: They jested as they passed by the trio and entered Underground Trier.
target: Iocabantur dum trio praeterierunt et ad Trier subterraneum intraverunt.

source: As he turned onto the nearest main street, the first thing Lumian saw was a scantily clad man in chains.
target: Cum ad viam principalem propinquissimam vertit, primum quod Lumian vidit, vir tenuis vestitus in catenis erat.

source: He crawled slowly along the street in a dog-like manner.
target: Lente per viam reperebat, more canino.

source: If anyone dared to glance at him, he would glare back and bark twice.
target: Si quis ausus esset eum intuendi, ille rigide respexit et bis latravit.

source: In the next moment, the street artists on the corner played a rhythmic melody.
target: In proximo momento, artifices plateae in angulo melodiam rhythmicam canebant.

source: Passersby more or less danced with relaxed and satisfied smiles on their faces.
target: Transiens viatores fere saltabant, vultibus leniter ac laete subridens.

source: The man acting as a dog and trembling in the cold wind also raised his hind leg.
target: Vir, canis imitando et in frigidis ventis trepidans, etiam crus posterius levavit.

source: This was very different from the streets in the market district.
target: Hoc valde differebat ab viis in regione mercaturae.

source: Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative was renowned for its numerous universities.
target: Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative notus erat plurimis universitatibus.

source: Lumian averted his gaze from the pedestrians’ smiles and led Lugano and Ludwig to Anthony’s nearby rented house.
target: Lumian oculos a risibus pedestrianorum avertit et Lugano atque Ludovicum ad domum locatam prope Anthony duxit.

source: It was on the fourth floor, near the end of the corridor.
target: Ea erat in quarto tabulato, prope finem corridorii.

source: Knock! Knock! Knock! Lumian knocked on the door without hesitation.
target: Trepida! Trepida! Trepida! Lumian ianuam sine mora pulsavit.

source: Soon, he saw Anthony, who was dressed differently from before.
target: Mox Anthony vidit, qui aliter quam antea indutus erat.

source: In a white shirt, light gray cashmere sweater, black tweed coat, dark-red bow tie, gold-rimmed glasses, and a light-yellow wig, his beard was cleanly shaven, and his face was no longer greasy.
target: Indutus camisia alba, subucula leviter cinerea, palton nigro ex tweedo, nodo rubro obscuro, oculis marginatis aureis, et parva capillo flavido, barba eius mundate abscissa erat, et facies eius non iam unguentata videbatur.

source: The black grime in his pores was gone.
target: Nigra immunditia in poris eius evanuerat.

source: He had the air of a successful member of high society.
target: Eius habitus significabat eum esse felicem membrum ordinis altissimi.

source: “Are you in a relationship?” Lumian jested.
target: "Esne in aliqua relatione amorosa?" iocatus est Lumian.

source: Anthony replied with a smile, “I’m attending a banquet hosted by the Trier Psychiatrist Guild today.”
target: Anthony subridens respondit: "Hodie ad convivium a Gilda Medicae Mentis Trieris hospitato adsum."

source: This was a necessary prerequisite for completing Madam Justice’s mission.
target: Hoc erat necessaria praevia condicio ad perficiendam missionem Dominae Iustitiae.

source: Lumian entered the room and asked casually, “Have you obtained a psychiatrist license?”
target: Lumian in conclave intravit et comiter quaesivit: "Licentiam psychiatricae acceperis?"

source: Anthony nodded.
target: Anthony annuit.

source: “I acquired a genuine identity and educational background.
target: "Veram identitatem et fundamenta educationis accepi.

source: During the interview, I successfully ‘convinced’ the examiner.”
target: Inter colloquium, examinatorum feliciter persuasi sum.

source: “A genuine identity?
target: "Vera identitas?

source: Where’s its original owner?” Lumian asked thoughtfully.
target: "Ubi est eius auctor originarius?" inquit Lumian cogitans.

source: Anthony glanced at Lugano and Ludwig but didn’t directly answer Lumian’s question.
target: Anthony Lugano et Ludovicum intuebatur, sed non directe quaestioni Lumiani respondit.

source: “What can I do for you?”
target: "Quid pro te facere possum?"

source: Lumian understood Anthony’s meaning and temporarily abandoned the question.
target: Lumian sensum Antonii intellexit et quaestionem per tempus reliquit.

source: He briefly mentioned the Dream Festival’s situation and the aftereffects of Lugano losing his arm in the dream.
target: Brevi memoravit rem Festivalis Somniorum et post effecta quod Lugano in somnio brachium amiserat.

source: He didn’t mention how Lugano had lost his arm.
target: Non memoravit quo modo Lugano brachium amisset.

source: Anthony listened attentively and looked at Lugano.
target: Anthony attente audivit et ad Lugano conspexit.

source: “Such hysteria is easily resolved.
target: "Talis hysteria facile solvitur.

source: Do you need a faster solution, or do you want it to be slower and gentler?”
target: "Vel solutionem rapidorem desideras, an mavis ut tardius et lenius fiat?"

source: Lugano replied without hesitation, “The faster one.”
target: Lugano sine mora respondit: "Celerior."

source: He had lost control of his right forearm!
target: Brachium dextrum suum imperii amisit!

source: Anthony’s gaze shifted to Lugano’s left side, furrowing his brow.
target: Aspectus Antonii ad partem sinistram Luganorum vertit, fronte corrugata.

source: Lugano subconsciously turned to his left and followed suit.
target: Lugano subconscie ad sinistram conversus, eius vestigium secutus est.

source: At that moment, Anthony produced a dagger from nowhere and thrust it at Lugano’s right forearm.
target: Illo momento, Anthony dagam ex nihilo extraxit et in brachium dextro Luganorum impulit.

source: Lugano swiftly retracted his hand and blurted out, “What are you doing!?”
target: Lugano celeriter manum retraxit et exclamavit: "Quid agis!?"

source: Anthony sheathed his dagger and replied calmly, “The treatment is over.”
target: Anthony dagam recubuit et tranquille respondit: "Cura finita est."

source: “Huh?” Lugano looked at his right hand in confusion and realized that it had “retracted” to his chest without being impeded.
target: "Quid?" Lugano manum dextram, confusus, aspexit et intellexit eam ad pectus retractam esse sine obstaculo.

source: Lumian chuckled and said to Lugano, “Keep an eye on Ludwig.
target: Lumian subridens ad Lugano dixit: "Circumspice Ludovicum.

source: Remember to prepare food for him.”
target: Memento ei cibum parare.

source: Without waiting for Lugano’s response, Lumian turned to Anthony.
target: Nisi responsum Luganorum exspectans, Lumian ad Anthoniam conversus est.

source: “Let’s go find Franca and Jenna now.”
target: "Eamus nunc Francam et Jennam invenire."

source: Anthony glanced at Lumian and adjusted the gold‐rimmed glasses he was unaccustomed to.
target: Anthony ad Lumian intuebatur et oculos auratis liminatis, quos non assuefactus erat, corrigebat.

source: “Alright.”
target: "Bene."
